name: Soga Tasuku
source:
Son of Azusa and Itaru. Both parents are always busy with work and have ended up spoiling him causing him to have developed a self-centered personality.

To meet his parents expectations he outwardly pretends to be an honor student and have excellent grades but among his peers, he shows a vulgar and rough side.

Due to his parents being elites, he tends to look down on others and believes that it is natural for the weak to be bullied by the strong.

[From [url=https://syuntada.com/boss/soga.html]official site[/url]]
